avis.titre: Love the tingle and its effectiveness
avis.texte: I love this stuff and Naturium's products in general. This serum is one I never forget to use especially on my fine lines. The price is great for the size bottle you get, too.

This is better than the BHA liquid exfoliating liquid. I like this glycolic acid resurfacing gel much more because it doesn't just air dry and disappear, it's a moisturizer as well. My makeup always looks so much better when I use this in the morning. I was recommended to use this to work on my skin texture. I think it has helped my skin a lot with my discoloration as well. I highly recommend this product.

I bought this product because the product I usually buy was not available. It is not as strong so I had to leave it on my skin for about 10 minutes before I saw any results. This product would be good for someone who has sensitive skin and wants to use a peeler.
I love this brand and I use several of their products and Ive never had a problem. This one however, I hate! Everytine Ive used it, it made me breakout like a teenager.
This product is amazing, this smooths my face and brightens it and I am using it twice a week, as recommended and I love it.
This product works great right off the bat it refreshed and renewed my tired out face I feel and look young again and I have sensitive skin and it does not irritate it at all
It's a Christmas gift for our granddaughter but I'm sure she'll love it because that's what she asked for
I normally have super picky reactive skin, very happy with this glycolic that doesn't irritate my skin!

This stuff is fabulous! I've used other overnight glycolic acids, and this one is just as effective, if not more effective, for a fraction of the cost! Skin is smoothed and brightened after a few uses.

I think that I have used all products for mature skin and I live them all. I take very good care if my skin and this company and the products that are offered enhance my skin care routine. I have my husband using products also. I love this line!
I was using the farmacy serum but this one is even better and does not dry my skin at all.

Had some very difficult dark spots on the side of my face that an esthi said could only be removed by freezing off. I'd tried dermaplaning, microderm abrasion, and other dark spot products. This product, along with daily dermaplaning, has almost removed these spots! Couldn't be more happy. Just know if doing this it is a pretty intense feeling (tingling and burning sensation) and you may need to work up to it vs doing it daily like I did.

Small whitehead patch breakout above my eyebrow the morning after . I applied this glycolic gel exfoliate Overnight , After cleansing with niacinamide gelee, and moisturizing with niacinamide gel cream moisturizer. Face tingled a bit upon application of the exfoliator (subsided quickly) eyebrows and jawline was itchy here and there. Woke up to a breakout. Plan on replacing AHA with BHA exfoliator and gel cream moisturizer with water gel moisturizer , in hopes this will be my personal skincare regimen. Fingers crossed !
I was pleasantly surprised with this. I feel the difference on my skin which is why I got it in the first place. Works extremely well with the rich moisturizer.
I like the consistency of this product and prefer a gel to a liquid toner for glycolic acid. It is a great product for clearing skin and combating breakouts.
I use this overnight under an overnight moisturizer. I alternate this with a retinol at nights and my skin has never looked better.
It tingles at first but my skin doesn't turn red or get irritated at all. My skin is so smooth the next morning
This has an elegant texture that feels like satin. After just two weeks I have noticed a brighter more even skin tone. I adore this product.

I have sensitive skin and well my skin had been balanced more than usual lately, but I was wondering should I risk my balanced skin trying something like glycolic acid? Well I did it and I must say my fine lines on my forehead have reduced by about 50% mine and my blackheads on my chin (most likely from mask) have almost disappeared! I tried BHA 2% and it did an ok job got rid of the darkest ones and prevented new one but mostly keep it stable but I've only used this 3 times and my blackheads are 90% gone! I've never had blackheads in this area so it was new territory for me but this helped so much! And my skin can tolerate it, I used it twice one week and once last week. I'm nervous to use it more than that but really happy with my purchase!

avis.titre: Buyer Beware. This is a strong gel.
avis.texte: I want to love this gel so much, but every time I use it, while my l my face comes out mostly fine, my neck gets crazy, painful burns. The sting is noticably more intense on my neck when I apply it (only once a week), and the next day it looks like I've been strangled. The burns lasts for a couple of days after. I've tried this three times with the same results.
I've been using this product for the past cpl wks & so far I hvnt noticed a change in my blemishes
Been using this product faithfully, and it has done wonders for my skin. I can't say enough about how great this product is.
Not sticky, overnight difference, leaves skin feeling smooth and even. Love the results so far!
I like these products so far, how they feel and smell or don't smell. I will have to update my review later as I use the product more to see how my skin looks, if there is any difference or not.

avis.titre: THE BEST (aka: please, please, please do not discontinue!)
avis.texte: IN LOVE!! I've purchased many products (mostly expensive) with Glycolic Acid and NONE of them offered the results that this one did!! You definitely feel it tingle when you apply (that says something!). I've see results within a week of using. My skin looks brighter, annoying breakouts have stopped and my skin is less congested. All that and at an amazing price! TO THE NATURIUM STAFF: PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE DO NOT DISCONTINUE THIS!
This is a great glycolic treatment. I use it twice a week and my skin has been smoother and more radiant. It is also quite hydrating. Would highly recommend!

This product has really improved my skin. I apply it before my serum and moisturizer and they all work well together. I had acne when younger and now have age spots at age 68. I wear less makeup since using these products. So happy I gave this brand a try!

My skin looks so dewy after just a few weeks...mid-40s and feel like I've at least slowed the aging process slightly. I use it a few times a week. My skin is also pretty sensitive but I haven't had any issues/breakouts.
i love the texture and one pump at least for me is all I need. I feel as though it has totally helped me to lighten some scars i've had on my right cheek! A repurchase for the future.
This is an amazing product as is their entire product line. I am a convert and will never use anything else on my face.
I use it after I exfoliate. It tingles a bit so you know it's working. Love it. Will buy it over and over again.

avis.titre: Only thing that has truly made a difference!
avis.texte: I am 28 y/o, have combination skin and have been battling with hormonal and regular acne my whole life. I have tried numerous products and regiments, changed my diet, exercise and sleeping habits, and nothing worked. But then I bought this product and OMG, my skin improved drastically in a matter of 2 weeks. I use it in the PM portion of my regiment, which is the following: BHA cleansing oil Krave gel cleanser Glycolic Acid gel (this product) Cerave Skin Renewing night cream I also changed my AM moisturizer with the niacinamide gel cream, which I'm sure has contributed to the improvement of my skin as well. So happy with these products, can't wait to try more! Thanks Susan Yara!!!!

I love glycolic acid, but please be careful as 10% can be highly sensitizing–specifically for skin of color individuals– as it can burn your skin and deep hyperpigmentation can appear. I returned mine and opted for Naturium's 8% glycolic acid, and I personally think the percentage makes all the difference. As a brown person, I'm still trying to figure out how to get ride of my burns because of the 10%, so be aware!!

I haven't used glycolic acid in a few months because I was getting maskne. So I wanted to stay away from actives for a little bit until my skin started to calm down. I was left with PIH and since I incorporated other ingredients into my skincare to reduce the inflammation, I thought I would give this another go. I forgot how much this can sting, however after 2 - 3 weeks, my skin has adjusted to it. I only use this 2-3 times a week which is more than enough for me. I do see a difference in my acne scars. They're finally fading away.
It's a great exfoliating product, and I have sensitive & acne-prone skin! I love how smooth my face feels after.
This is a nightly routine for me. My skin has never looked better.
This is the best stuff I have ever put on my face! I switch between this and my adapalene my skin is glowing! Thanks Naturium
This glycolic acid doesn't make my skin dry at all. It's really nice and helps with my pores

For me, the resurfacing gel works wonderfully. Using it every other night on trouble spots has been very helpful. It has only been a couple of weeks but I love it! It helps to shrink my blemishes quickly. It can be drying so using a moisturizer, as suggested, is a great idea. A little goes a long way so use sparingly. I'm glad that I tried this product. It is a great addition to my routine and I will continue to use occasionally when I'm experiencing breakouts.

I absolutely love this product and would highly recommend it to anyone! I have acne and I use Retin-A (tretinoin) I use the combination of the two on opposite nights and my skin has never ever looked better! And when I say I have acne I've had horrible cystic acne for 12 years my skin Is CLEAR now.
